hypothesis.statement: At unchanged fixed-normalization relational Sarsa settings, one million training transitions resolve the food/thermal tradeoff seen at100k and produce balanced needs across3 training seeds.
hypothesis.rationale: Fixed normalization acquired food and safety on all3 seeds, but lambda0 temperature remained poor; lambda.9 preserved thermal control but acquired food on only one seed. More experience may fit competing state-dependent action values without new motivation or hyperparameter tuning. This is a new hypothesis after the100k non-regression gate failed, not promotion of the failed pilot.
hypothesis.falsification: Reject satisfactory acquisition unless all six unchanged criteria pass on every one of3 training seeds at the final1M policy. Report every100k point and all evaluation worlds. A candidate must then pass a separately registered independent confirmation with new training/evaluation seeds; no single-seed success, mean-only success or retrospective checkpoint replacement.

sources.title: Live normalization-pilot-01 preregistered results
sources.mechanism: Longer exposure alone, while preserving independently acquired needs; investigate continued-learning curves rather than alter several mechanisms together.
sources.limitations: This is a convergence hypothesis, not a guarantee that the chosen representation or scalar discounted objective admits the required policy. Reused pilot seeds are exploratory, not independent confirmation.

protocol.controls: Fixed lambda0/.9, exact prior parameters alpha.03/gamma.97/epsilon1->.05 in50k. Runner random/untrained/initial frozen. The100k point must reproduce the prior pilot exactly, despite additional later training and a different evaluation schedule.
protocol.checkpointRule: Final1M only. Earlier success or collapse is reported, never used to select a replacement policy. No restarting bad seeds.
protocol.compute: Two CPU workers while RAM reserve2GiB holds;10-minute slices, per-trial timeout8min, completed trials preserved. User removed duration cap.
protocol.nextIfNegative: Revisit temporal objective/continuing average reward or learn a structured forward model of needs; do not keep extending this learner indefinitely.

decisionRule: Final1M policy only. All6 unchanged behavior criteria must pass on all3 training seeds before independent full confirmation. Report all100k curves and evaluation worlds, no best-checkpoint/seed selection. If negative change temporal objective or learning mechanism, not endless exposure.
